reason: In the non-SQLite branch of deleteByIDs (xorm_store.go, patch lines 328-331), the code adds one `?` placeholder per ID and binds every ID as a separate argument, with nothing capping the count. AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize is read with MustInt64(100) and no upper limit (pkg/setting/setting.go:710), and the repository does not set interpolateParams for MySQL, so any batch size above 65535 exceeds the MySQL/Postgres bind-parameter limit.
